title: Shining Heist: Diamond's Deceit
story: In a dimly lit, opulent room filled with priceless artifacts, the night took a sinister turn. The elegant and wealthy socialite, Lady Vivian, was found lifeless, sprawled across a massive ruby chandelier that now lay shattered around her. The room, known for its dazzling collection of gems, was now a chaotic scene with a missing 100-carat Pink Star diamond. This enchanting gem, worth millions, was securely displayed in an impenetrable glass case before the tragedy occurred.
crimeScene: The opulent gemstone room of Lord Abbeythorpe Manor
forensicClue: The distinct smell of lavender hairspray was detected at the crime scene.
question: Who stole the Pink Star diamond and how did they escape unnoticed?
options: Option A: Suspect 1 - The dashing Lord Abbeythorpe (and escape method)
Option B: Suspect 2 - The disgruntled employee (and escape method)
Option C: Suspect 3 - The enigmatic art collector (and escape method)
Option D: Suspect 4 - The rival gem merchant (and escape method)
